stemMarkdown: The speeds of A and B are in the ratio 4 : 3. In a 400 m race, how many metres of a head start must A give B so that the race ends in a dead heat? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 400 m, B covers $400 \times \dfrac{3}{4} = 300.0000$ m. For a tie, B must be started ahead by the shortfall: $100.0$ m.
